note: AI drafted for Querycraft v2 (2026-11-23). Every gold query is executed by scripts/iowa_questions.py and must return rows; nobody has checked the answers by hand yet. Warehouse: scripts/load_iowa_liquor.py --max-rows 2000000 (invoice lines 2022-01-02 to 2022-10-19).

questions.question: How many stores are in Des Moines?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stores WHERE city = 'Des Moines'

questions.question: What were total sales in dollars in January 2022?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(sale_dollars) FROM sales WHERE date BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-01-31'

questions.question: How many bottles were sold in total?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(bottles_sold) FROM sales

questions.question: Which vendor had the highest total sales in dollars?
questions.sql: SELECT v.vendor_name FROM sales s JOIN items i ON s.item_number = i.item_number JOIN vendors v ON i.vendor_number = v.vendor_number GROUP BY v.vendor_number ORDER BY SUM(s.sale_dollars) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: List the five items with the most bottles sold, from most to least.
questions.sql: SELECT i.item_description FROM sales s JOIN items i ON s.item_number = i.item_number GROUP BY s.item_number ORDER BY SUM(s.bottles_sold) DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Which county had the highest total sales in dollars?
questions.sql: SELECT c.county FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON s.store_number = st.store_number JOIN counties c ON st.county_number = c.county_number GROUP BY c.county_number ORDER BY SUM(s.sale_dollars) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the average sale in dollars per invoice line at stores in Polk county?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(s.sale_dollars) FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON s.store_number = st.store_number JOIN counties c ON st.county_number = c.county_number WHERE c.county = 'Polk'

questions.question: How many different items does JIM BEAM BRANDS supply?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items i JOIN vendors v ON i.vendor_number = v.vendor_number WHERE v.vendor_name = 'JIM BEAM BRANDS'

questions.question: How many liters of vodka were sold in total?
questions.evidence: vodka refers to categories whose name contains VODKA
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(s.volume_sold_liters) FROM sales s JOIN items i ON s.item_number = i.item_number JOIN categories c ON i.category_number = c.category_number WHERE c.category_name LIKE '%VODKA%'

questions.question: Which month had the highest total sales in dollars?
questions.sql: SELECT substr(date, 1, 7) FROM sales GROUP BY substr(date, 1, 7) ORDER BY SUM(sale_dollars) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the name of the store with the largest total sales in dollars?
questions.sql: SELECT st.store_name FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON s.store_number = st.store_number GROUP BY s.store_number ORDER BY SUM(s.sale_dollars) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many invoice lines were for items with a bottle volume of 1750 ml?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales s JOIN items i ON s.item_number = i.item_number WHERE i.bottle_volume_ml = 1750

questions.question: What is the average state bottle retail price on invoice lines for straight bourbon whiskies?
questions.evidence: straight bourbon whiskies refers to category_name = 'STRAIGHT BOURBON WHISKIES'
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(s.state_bottle_retail) FROM sales s JOIN items i ON s.item_number = i.item_number JOIN categories c ON i.category_number = c.category_number WHERE c.category_name = 'STRAIGHT BOURBON WHISKIES'

questions.question: How many stores sold Titos Handmade Vodka in March 2022?
questions.evidence: Titos Handmade Vodka refers to item_description = 'TITOS HANDMADE VODKA'
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_number) FROM sales s JOIN items i ON s.item_number = i.item_number WHERE i.item_description = 'TITOS HANDMADE VODKA' AND s.date BETWEEN '2022-03-01' AND '2022-03-31'

questions.question: What were the total sales in dollars of the three cities with the highest sales, from highest to lowest?
questions.sql: SELECT st.city, SUM(s.sale_dollars) FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON s.store_number = st.store_number GROUP BY st.city ORDER BY SUM(s.sale_dollars) DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: How many different vendors had items sold in Linn county?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.vendor_number) FROM sales s JOIN items i ON s.item_number = i.item_number JOIN stores st ON s.store_number = st.store_number JOIN counties c ON st.county_number = c.county_number WHERE c.county = 'Linn'

questions.question: What percentage of total sales in dollars came from Polk county?
questions.evidence: percentage = 100 * Polk county sales / all sales
questions.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN c.county = 'Polk' THEN s.sale_dollars ELSE 0 END) / SUM(s.sale_dollars) FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON s.store_number = st.store_number JOIN counties c ON st.county_number = c.county_number

questions.question: Which category sold the most bottles?
questions.sql: SELECT c.category_name FROM sales s JOIN items i ON s.item_number = i.item_number JOIN categories c ON i.category_number = c.category_number GROUP BY c.category_name ORDER BY SUM(s.bottles_sold) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: On which date were the most bottles sold?
questions.sql: SELECT date FROM sales GROUP BY date ORDER BY SUM(bottles_sold) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What was the state's total gross profit in February 2022?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM((state_bottle_retail - state_bottle_cost) * bottles_sold) FROM sales WHERE date BETWEEN '2022-02-01' AND '2022-02-28'

questions.question: How many stores have the zip code 52240?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stores WHERE zip_code = '52240'

questions.question: Which three vendors had the most different items sold, from most to fewest?
questions.sql: SELECT v.vendor_name FROM sales s JOIN items i ON s.item_number = i.item_number JOIN vendors v ON i.vendor_number = v.vendor_number GROUP BY v.vendor_number ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT s.item_number) DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: What is the average number of bottles per invoice line for items that come in packs of 6?
questions.sql: SELECT AVG(s.bottles_sold) FROM sales s JOIN items i ON s.item_number = i.item_number WHERE i.pack = 6

questions.question: Which item was sold at the highest state bottle retail price?
questions.sql: SELECT i.item_description FROM sales s JOIN items i ON s.item_number = i.item_number ORDER BY s.state_bottle_retail DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many invoice lines were sold in Story county in April 2022?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON s.store_number = st.store_number JOIN counties c ON st.county_number = c.county_number WHERE c.county = 'Story' AND s.date BETWEEN '2022-04-01' AND '2022-04-30'

questions.question: Which store in Cedar Rapids sold the most liters?
questions.sql: SELECT st.store_name FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON s.store_number = st.store_number WHERE st.city = 'Cedar Rapids' GROUP BY s.store_number ORDER BY SUM(s.volume_sold_liters) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What were total sales in dollars of items whose description contains FIREBALL?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(s.sale_dollars) FROM sales s JOIN items i ON s.item_number = i.item_number WHERE i.item_description LIKE '%FIREBALL%'

questions.question: How many counties had total sales of more than one million dollars?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT st.county_number FROM sales s JOIN stores st ON s.store_number = st.store_number GROUP BY st.county_number HAVING SUM(s.sale_dollars) > 1000000)

questions.question: What were DIAGEO AMERICAS' total sales in dollars from April through June 2022?
questions.sql: SELECT SUM(s.sale_dollars) FROM sales s JOIN items i ON s.item_number = i.item_number JOIN vendors v ON i.vendor_number = v.vendor_number WHERE v.vendor_name = 'DIAGEO AMERICAS' AND s.date BETWEEN '2022-04-01' AND '2022-06-30'

questions.question: How many different stores sold mezcal?
questions.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.store_number) FROM sales s JOIN items i ON s.item_number = i.item_number JOIN categories c ON i.category_number = c.category_number WHERE c.category_name = 'MEZCAL'
